--src: Mathlib.Logic.Small.Defs
/-- A type is `Small.{w}` if there exists an equivalence to some `S : Type w`.
-/
@[mk_iff, pp_with_univ]
class Small (α : Type v) : Prop where
  /-- If a type is `Small.{w}`, then there exists an equivalence with some `S : Type w` -/
  equiv_small : ∃ S : Type w, Nonempty (α ≃ S)

--src: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.FinallySmall
/-- The converse is true if `J` is filtered, see `finallySmall_of_small_weakly_terminal_set`. -/
theorem FinallySmall.exists_small_weakly_terminal_set [FinallySmall.{w} J] :
    ∃ (s : Set J) (_ : Small.{w} s), ∀ i, ∃ j ∈ s, Nonempty (i ⟶ j) := by
  refine ⟨Set.range (fromFinalModel J).obj, inferInstance, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f⟩ : Nonempty (StructuredArrow i (fromFinalModel J)) := IsConnected.is_nonempty
  exact ⟨(fromFinalModel J).obj f.right, Set.mem_range_self _, ⟨f.hom⟩⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Option.Basic
theorem exists_mem_map {f : α → β} {o : Option α} {p : β → Prop} :
    (∃ y ∈ o.map f, p y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ o, p (f x) := by simp

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.Rank
/-- if `r a b` then the rank of `a` is less than the rank of `b`. -/
theorem rank_lt_of_rel (hb : Acc r b) (h : r a b) : (hb.inv h).rank < hb.rank :=
  (Order.lt_succ _).trans_le <| by
    rw [hb.rank_eq]
    exact Ordinal.le_iSup _ (⟨a, h⟩ : {a // r a b})

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.SmallSets
theorem eventually_smallSets' {p : Set α → Prop} (hp : ∀ ⦃s t⦄, s ⊆ t → p t → p s) :
    (∀ᶠ s in l.smallSets, p s) ↔ ∃ s ∈ l, p s :=
  eventually_smallSets.trans <|
    exists_congr fun s => Iff.rfl.and ⟨fun H => H s Subset.rfl, fun hs _t ht => hp ht hs⟩

--src: Mathlib.Order.Minimal
theorem not_maximal_subset_iff (hs : P s) : ¬ Maximal P s ↔ ∃ t, s ⊂ t ∧ P t :=
  not_maximal_iff_exists_gt hs

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Basic
theorem SetCoe.exists {s : Set α} {p : s → Prop} :
    (∃ x : s, p x) ↔ ∃ (x : _) (h : x ∈ s), p ⟨x, h⟩ :=
  Subtype.exists

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Basic
theorem not_bddAbove_compl_of_small (s : Set Nimber.{u}) [Small.{u} s] : ¬ BddAbove sᶜ :=
  Ordinal.not_bddAbove_compl_of_small s

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.PartENat
theorem lt_def (x y : PartENat) : x < y ↔ ∃ hx : x.Dom, ∀ hy : y.Dom, x.get hx < y.get hy := by
  rw [lt_iff_le_not_le, le_def, le_def, not_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hyx, H⟩, h⟩
    by_cases hx : x.Dom
    · use hx
      intro hy
      specialize H hy
      specialize h fun _ => hy
      rw [not_forall] at h
      cases' h with hx' h
      rw [not_le] at h
      exact h
    · specialize h fun hx' => (hx hx').elim
      rw [not_forall] at h
      cases' h with hx' h
      exact (hx hx').elim
  · rintro ⟨hx, H⟩
    exact ⟨⟨fun _ => hx, fun hy => (H hy).le⟩, fun hxy h => not_lt_of_le (h _) (H _)⟩

@[simp]
theorem subset_sSup_def [Inhabited s] :
    @sSup s _ = fun t =>
      if ht : t.Nonempty ∧ BddAbove t ∧ sSup ((↑) '' t : Set α) ∈ s
      then ⟨sSup ((↑) '' t : Set α), ht.2.2⟩
      else default :=
  rfl

    use ht
    exact ha
